title: Team USA × VOW
lede: An interactive concept for event operations and guest experiences across a multi-venue sporting event.

cover.alt: Athletes and guests in a hospitality lounge overlooking a floodlit stadium

statement: Every guest, every arrival and every moment, in one live view.
note: This case study is an interactive concept. It shows how VOW could run hospitality for a national team across several venues, with one view of every guest.

sections.title: The Challenge
text: Hospitality around a national team is shared by many groups at once: athlete families, sponsors, partners and VIP guests. Each group has its own lists, its own tickets and its own arrival times.
Those details usually sit in separate spreadsheets and message threads. The team in charge has to piece the picture together by hand, while the event is already under way.

sections.title: The Solution
text: VOW PRO gives the operations team one live view: every guest, every group, every seat. Venue maps, check-in and communications sit in the same place.
VOW GO gives each guest a digital pass, a personal schedule and a concierge, on web or mobile. The guest always knows where to go, and the team always knows where the guest is.

results.title: What the Concept Shows
text: One shared picture replaces many separate ones. Guests arrive to a pass that is ready, the team sees every change as it happens, and nobody has to ask who is where.
The same approach carries over to any event of this size, from a single night to a full programme.
